title: Wait till you hear him on Hamlet
html_source: We readers will get to “hear” Stephen discourse extensively on Hamlet in Chapter 9.

anchor.text: Wait till you hear him on Hamlet
anchor.prefix:
about the cracked lookingglass of a servant being the symbol of Irish art is deuced good. 

 Buck Mulligan kicked Stephen's foot under the table and said with warmth of tone: 

 —
anchor.suffix:
, Haines. 

 — Well, I mean it, Haines said, still speaking to Stephen. I was just thinking of it when that poor old creature came in. 

 — Would I make money by it? Stephen asked.
